keywords: LUCID 加密内存池 EIP 合并
一个 slot 即不可回滚的快速确认
无需签名的后量子以太坊
summary: anderselowsson 的 LUCID 加密内存池 EIP 合并为草案（EIP-8184）。soispoke 在此基础上发表加密 frame 交易，结合 LUCID 与 EIP-8141，在区块排序锁定前隐藏目标、calldata 与金额。VitalikButerin 推介快速确认规则：在超多数诚实、网络延迟约 3 秒以内的前提下，一个 slot 后即可获得不回滚保证。后量子方向有两篇研究：用 ZK 直接证明授权语义以免去签名，以及 Falcon 签名聚合在内存池中的收益。

items.title: ethresear.ch：加密 frame 交易
items.note: （soispoke）20:05：在任何解密密钥公开前，builder 先承诺完整的有序交易集合，公开后在同一 slot 按已承诺顺序执行，从而实现同 slot 加密执行，无需把区块拆成加密段和明文段；设计复用 LUCID 与 EIP-8141；作者推文 20:08。
items.note_en: (soispoke), 20:05: the builder commits to the full ordered transaction set before any decryption key is revealed, then executes that committed order in the same slot after reveal, so same slot encrypted execution works without splitting the block into encrypted and plaintext sections; the design reuses LUCID and EIP-8141; author thread, 20:08.

items.title: EIP-8037：明确常规 gas 必须先于状态 gas 扣除
items.note: （spencer-tb）提交：在 gas 重定价会议之后，规定操作码同时需要常规 gas 与状态 gas 时先扣常规 gas，若常规 gas 不足则不消耗状态 gas，防止子 frame 失败时父 frame 的储备被抬高。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: clarify regular gas must be charged before state gas
items.note_en: (spencer-tb), submitted: following the gas repricing call, when an opcode needs both regular and state gas the regular charge comes first, and if it runs out of gas no state gas is consumed, which keeps the parent's reservoir from inflating when a child frame fails.

keywords_en: a fast confirmation guarantee after one slot
summary_en: anderselowsson's LUCID encrypted mempool EIP merged as a draft (EIP-8184). soispoke built on it with encrypted frame transactions, combining LUCID and EIP-8141 to hide target, calldata and amounts until block ordering is locked. VitalikButerin highlighted the fast confirmation rule: with an honest supermajority and network latency under about 3 seconds, a transaction cannot revert after one slot. Two post-quantum studies appeared: proving authorization semantics directly in ZK without a signature, and the benefit of aggregating Falcon signatures in the mempool.
